capabilities: Log sets with reps, weight, duration, distance or custom fields
Show sets in tables grouped by day with daily totals
Chart weight, volume, reps, pace and heart rate with a trend header
Display a dashboard with streaks, personal records and a muscle heat map
Run countdown, interval and stopwatch rest timers
extras: Conflicts with the Workout Block plugin: both register workout-log code blocks and default to workout_logs.csv, so only one can be enabled. No account or cloud; data stays in a vault CSV. Available in 24 languages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log training sets and follow progress, so workout data ends up in separate apps or hand-made tables.

relations.evidence: You can query your sets from Dataview.
Every set in one plain CSV file, readable from Dataview and Templater

summary: Workout tracker that logs sets to one CSV and shows them in tables, charts, a dashboard with a muscle heat map, and rest timers.
